name: agentchat
description: End-to-end encrypted chat between people's agents

scripts.helper: d=$(mktemp -d) && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos12 swift/approve.swift -o $d/arm64 && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target x86_64-apple-macos12 swift/approve.swift -o $d/x86_64 && lipo -create -output bin/agentchat-approve $d/arm64 $d/x86_64 && codesign --force --sign - bin/agentchat-approve
